u8_relocation_fcu_geometry.note: U8-F is feasible only if some module centre lies outside the display outline while the module stays on MAIN. Necessary bounds: centre <= R_main - s/2 = 18.00 mm (inscribed-circle containment) and centre > R_display = 21.95 mm (the centre is a point of the module). 18.00 < 21.95, so no F.Cu position of a 10 mm module escapes the rigid display; the lever cannot remove U8 from the governing front-gap stack (RF evidence not even reached). The earlier R_main - circumradius bound was orientation-dependent and is replaced by this valid necessary-condition pair.

window_plate.model: Linear small-deflection Kirchhoff plate, circular, uniform pressure. Support bounds: clamped edge = OPTIMISTIC / stronger-support bound (assumes verified edge rotation restraint); simply-supported edge = conservative / weaker-support bound and the sizing case. Outcomes are reported per support independently; a row passes only if the simply-supported bound passes. Validity limit: flagged where w/t > 0.5 (membrane stiffening then makes the linear result conservative). Analytical model with PARAMETRIC planning properties only - NOT a 5 ATM qualification; the actual window geometry, material and bond restraint remain unresolved (G2 pod concept / G3 caseback, ATM-Q2 window variant, X23) and any clamped-only pass is CONDITIONAL ON VERIFIED CLAMPED/RESTRAINED SUPPORT.

rows.support_result: CONDITIONAL ON VERIFIED CLAMPED/RESTRAINED SUPPORT (clamped bound passes, simply-supported bound fails)
CONDITIONAL ON VERIFIED CLAMPED/RESTRAINED SUPPORT (clamped bound passes, simply-supported bound fails)
CONDITIONAL ON VERIFIED CLAMPED/RESTRAINED SUPPORT (clamped bound passes, simply-supported bound fails)

window_plate.verdict: 1 of 18 material/thickness/corner combinations pass the conservative simply-supported bound; 3 more pass only the clamped (optimistic) bound and are CONDITIONAL ON VERIFIED CLAMPED/RESTRAINED SUPPORT - the window bond restraint is unresolved and stays gated. No analytical result here is a 5 ATM qualification (ATM-Q2, X23 retained).

electrical_evidence.assessment: 0402 MLCC in 4.7 uF and 2.2 uF exist as a class (no MPN invented). At 3.0 V a 6.3 V-class 0402 4.7 uF part loses a large share of its capacitance to DC bias; the effective capacitance must be checked against eMMC VCC guidance and, if short, C901 split into two 0402 parts (same height) or C902/C901 re-balanced. C903 at 1.8 V has less derating. Electrically valid in principle; requires the later MAIN BOM/placement task. G1 changes no schematic or footprint.
electrical_evidence.rail_source: 09_STORAGE.kicad_sch sheet notes (read-only): 'VCC = VOUT2_3V0_PROVISIONAL. Kingston allows 2.7-3.6 V', 'VCCQ = VOUT1_1V8', 'C901/C902: VCC 4.7uF + 220nF. C903/C904: VCCQ 2.2uF + 100nF'
electrical_evidence.voltage_rating: no voltage-rating property on C901/C903 in the schematic or BOM (no MPN); a later task must select the rating

g1_verdict.note: Stop rule (G1_BRIEF.md 4.6): no scenario is credibly <= 15.5 mm, so the G1 verdict is THICKNESS OWNER DECISION REQUIRED; the tradeoff table is presented and no requirement is weakened. OD-COVER and OD-REAR-SIDED are NOT revoked.
g1_verdict.rule: credible = nominal <= 15.5 AND RSS <= 15.5, every lever CREDIBLE_LATER_TASK, cover plate PASS/PASS_NOMINAL with air-gap PASS, no failed deterministic check, no best-case supplier value; the linear worst case is reported, not required
